'''''Viburnum propinquum''''', the '''Chinese evergreen viburnum''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Viburnaceae]], native to central and southern China, Taiwan, and [[Luzon]] in the Philippines.<ref name="149881-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:149881-1 |title=''Viburnum propinquum'' Hemsl. |author=<!--Not stated--> |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=5 November 2021 }}</ref> A dense, rounded evergreen bush reaching {{cvt|6|–|8|ft}}, and useful for landscaping applications, it is hardy to [[Hardiness zone|USDA zone 7]].<ref name="MBG_279014" >{{cite web |url=https://www.missouribotanicalgarden.org/PlantFinder/PlantFinderDetails.aspx?taxonid=279014 |title=''Viburnum propinquum'' |author=<!--Not stated--> |date= |website=Plant Finder |publisher=Missouri Botanical Garden |access-date=5 November 2021 }}</ref>
